name: Amami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Amami city emblem in grey, light blue and red: a grey and light blue oval with a white stylised figure and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Amami, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.
